final: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM cat WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT cat.ratio, cat.cnt, overall.avg_cnt FROM cat JOIN overall ON overall.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE cat.cnt > overall.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM kept
